description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate logging with potential chaining to other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing LogNode interface to enable chained logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which logs are passed.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable; passes log to next node if configured.
